name: qa-experimentation
description: Experimentation harness testing: SDK-specific testing for Statsig, Optimizely, VWO, Amplitude Experiment; sample-ratio-mismatch (SRM) detection; AB-test validity checklist; guardrail-metrics + peeking-problem references. Distinct from qa-shift-right/feature-flag-experiment-validator (validates experiment results); this plugin tests the experimentation harness itself (SDK behaviour, assignment integrity, statistical-validity gates).
